Tenant 73 improved from about 2,417 queries/38–39 seconds to 37 queries/4.3–4.5 seconds and 184 MB peak memory. A regression test asserts 37 queries; the report suite passes with 63 passed and 2 skipped due to unavailable PostgreSQL.
